name: @teactjs/i18n
description: Internationalization for Teact — locale detection & persistence, built-in UI string packs, LanguagePicker and Intl formatting hooks

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/locales/index.ts --root ./src --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external i18next --external react-i18next --external '@teactjs/*' && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json
